title: Dutch Oven Roasted Challots
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for roasted challots in a Dutch oven. This dish is perfect for a weeknight meal or a special occasion.
instructions: Peel the challots and place them in a single layer in the Dutch oven.
Drizzle the olive oil over the challots and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Toss the challots to coat them evenly with the oil and spices.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and roast the challots in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until they are tender and caramelized.
While the challots are roasting, prepare the pilaf according to the package instructions.
When the challots are done, remove them from the oven and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Serve the roasted challots over the pilaf and enjoy!
